events.title: Fully Steam Deck Compatible
events.summary: Did you know that Please File Accurately is fully compatible with the Steam Deck?Controller icons? Yep we show the correct controller icons for the deck, xbox controllers, playstation, some others, and even for keyboard usage. And of course you can always see the controls from the pause menu and help screen.How about tvs? events.title: Demo Update: Track Your Progress
events.summary: Small update released today - you can now track your progress and see how well you've done on the two demo levels - one star, two stars, or three stars. How well can you complete the tasks? Or did you get fired again?

events.title: Please File Accurately Demo Out Now
events.summary: The demo for Please File Accurately is now out! Four coworkers stuck in one office. No reason to behave professionally. Complete the tasks, work together, sabotage each other, or destroy the office in this chaotic local 4-player party game.This demo includes two levels from the final game as well as a few of the collectable cosmetics to enjoy straight away. The final game will has a ton more levels... coming soon in Jan 2027.

events.title: Demo of Please File Accurately is coming soon
events.summary: We are working hard to get a demo build out and ready, so you've got something to enjoy between now and January! Get a taste of the competitive co-operative play which is Please File Accurately.Will you put the office together and get the jobs done? Or are you keen to tear the office to pieces and cause mayhem and carnage?Our demo will be complete with full controller support for up to four players, Steam Deck and handheld support, split controller and split keyboard options.
